vocabulary.definition: the process of reuniting or bringing together again, especially a country or group of people
vocabulary.example: The reunification of East and West Germany was a historic event in 1990.

vocabulary.definition: not helping or supporting either side in a conflict, disagreement, etc.; impartial
vocabulary.example: Switzerland has a long history of being a neutral country in international affairs.

vocabulary.definition: in spoken rather than written words; orally
vocabulary.example: She gave me a verbally agreement to the terms of the contract.

vocabulary.definition: to cause something, such as a road, bridge, etc., to go out or up; to stretch out
vocabulary.example: The company plans to extend its operations to new markets next year.

vocabulary.definition: able to be imagined or believed; conceivable
vocabulary.example: The scale of destruction caused by the earthquake was beyond imaginable.

vocabulary.definition: a formally concluded and ratified agreement between countries
vocabulary.example: The peace treaty ended the conflict between the two nations.
